**Automatic updates.** ProCalc now keeps itself up to date, so this is the last version you
need to download by hand.

- When ProCalc starts, it quietly checks for a new version. If there is one, you'll see what's
  new and can **Install now**, be reminded later, or skip that version.
- Updates download, install and restart ProCalc for you. A project with a file is saved first;
  an unsaved one asks before restarting.
- **Settings → Updates** shows your version and has a **Check now** button and a switch to turn
  automatic checks off.
- Every update is signed and checked before it's installed.
- The portable zips can't replace themselves, so they offer a download link instead.
